title: Technology Sector Update for 02/01/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, BABA, KEM, VOD, NOK
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.0%
AAPL: -0.4%
IBM: -0.1%
CSCO: -1%
GOOG: +0.3%
Technology shares were mixed in pre-market trading on Thursday.
Expected movers:
- Alibaba Group Holding ( BABA ): posts mixed fiscal Q3, lifts FY18 revenue guidance; buys 33% stake in Ant Financial
- Kemet ( KEM ): fiscal Q3 results beat views; invests in Novasentis, forms China JV
- Vodafone ( VOD ): reiterates full-year guidance despite drop in third quarter sales
- Nokia ( NOK ): Q4 adjusted earnings, revenue exceed estimates
